主要内容: On February 20, 2020, Nicholas Financial, Inc. entered into and closed a Purchase and Sale Agreement with Platinum Auto Finance of Tampa Bay, LLC (d/b/a Platinum) and Finanza Acceptance LLC to acquire approximately $19 million of Platinum’s active and performing portfolio of retail installment sales contracts secured by motor vehicle liens and certain promissory notes and related security interests in motor vehicles. The purchase price was 95% of par value, with a portion held in escrow and subject to reduction under the agreement’s recourse provisions. This is the Company’s third bulk portfolio purchase of receivables from Platinum, following two prior transactions of $1.1 million and $0.9 million. The Company has also been cooperating with Platinum on joint venture initiatives, including cross-marketing and application pass-throughs. The transaction is part of Nicholas Financial, Inc.’s strategy to expand its portfolio of receivables and enhance its market position in the financial services industry.

股票实体.名称: Platinum Auto Finance of Tampa Bay, LLC
